content.short: LOBSTR is a simple, non-custodial wallet for the Stellar and XRP Ledger networks, with built-in buying, swaps and trading.
content.description: Many XLM and XRP holders start with LOBSTR. On mobile or the web, users buy crypto with a card, send and receive payments, swap between assets and trade on Stellar's built-in exchange from the same portfolio view. Accounts can be protected with a PIN, two-factor authentication and multisig. More than a million people use it. The team also makes LOBSTR Vault for multisig signing, a signer browser extension and the StellarTerm and StellarX trading interfaces. LOBSTR is run by an independent company with no affiliation to the Stellar Development Foundation.
